answer: Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a nebula index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Because the willow index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the cedar audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 164 aliases thus needs 164 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
